rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a Protestant church minister or pastor.

example.english: The pastor preached very vividly this Sunday.
example.traditional: 今個星期日牧師講道講得好生動。
example.jyutping: gam1 go3 sing1 kei4 jat6 muk6 si1 gong2 dou6 gong2 dak1 hou2 saang1 dung6

rows.note: Use this specifically for a Catholic priest rather than a Protestant 牧師.

example.english: The pastor prayed for the sick after Mass.
example.traditional: 神父喺彌撒後為病人祈禱。
example.jyutping: san4 fu6 hai2 nei4 saat3 hau6 wai6 beng6 jan4 kei4 tou2

rows.note: Use this in evangelical or preaching-focused contexts when referring to a Christian minister as a religious worker.

example.english: This pastor often travels around preaching the gospel.
example.traditional: 呢位傳道人成日周圍去向人傳福音。
example.jyutping: nei1 wai6 cyun4 dou6 jan4 seng4 jat6 zau1 wai4 heoi3 hoeng3 jan4 cyun4 fuk1 jam1
